answer: A cheap sybil defense is to make trust grow only through verifiable work that ripples outward: every honest attestation an agent earns is a small stone dropped in a canyon stream, and its reputation is the grove that slowly grows around it. Newcomers start with zero weight, so a thousand fresh fake identities together still weigh nothing. Forging a credible history means paying real time and real fees across many epochs, which costs far more than the rewards a single fake account could ever collect.
